The '''Dark Sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword weapon]] that can be obtained as a [[Monsters|Monster]] drop from [[Haunted Skull]]s in the [[Quarry Mine]] or dungeon floors in [[The Mines]]. It is the slowest sword in the game, at −5 {{Name|Speed w|class=inline}}.

The Dark Sword comes with the [[Forge#Enchantments|vampiric enchantment]] when obtained from [[Haunted Skull]]s. The enchantment can be changed at the [[Forge]].

==Notes==
* Damage dealt by explosions may also trigger healing as long as the Dark Sword is held. This includes the 999 damage inflicted upon downed [[Mummy|Mummies]] by explosions.
* It has the slowest speed and highest weight of any sword in the game.

==History==
{{History|1.0|Existed in game code, but was most likely unimplemented (see [https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/9s1k8k/has_anyone_ever_found_these_items/e940zyk/ ConcernedApe comment on reddit])}}<!--archive link: https://archive.ph/eRhkZ-->
{{History|1.4|Officially introduced in game. Description changed from "It's glowing with a mysterious energy."  Crit chance changed from .05 to .04.}}
{{History|1.5|Healing effect changed from 8% to 9%+; sword comes with [[Forge#Enchantments|vampiric enchantment]]. Level raised from 8 to 9 and sell price raised from {{Price|400}} to {{Price|450}}.}}
